outcome: Maternal morbidities (anemia, anxiety, cesarean delivery, prolonged hospital stay)
cohort: Women discharged from hospital after delivery in the United States between 1998 and 2009
finding: There is an increase in the prevalence of cervical cancer during pregnancy, and its presence is associated with higher odds of various maternal and fetal morbidities.
mod_finding: Cervical cancer was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery (AOR, 1.67, 95% CI, 1.46-1.90).
